text: If you fear the Lord and obey his Law, you will find Wisdom when you search.
She will care for you like your own mother and welcome you, as a bride welcomes her husband.
And instead of something to eat and drink, she will give you wisdom and understanding.
You can depend on her to keep you from disgrace.
She will tell you what to say, and you will be honored because of your wise speeches in town meetings.
Your life will be happy, and you will be remembered for all time.
But fools and sinners will never find Wisdom.
She won't come near the proud or enter the mind of a liar.
That's why the Lord refuses to accept praise from sinners.
Only the wise can offer acceptable praise.
The Lord hates it when you say that he forced you to sin.
And he doesn't like sinners, so don't claim he tempted you to become one.
The Lord and all who fear him hate disgusting sins.
The Lord created us humans, and from the very beginning, he gave us the ability to choose how we will live.
You are able to obey his Law if you really want to, and you can please him by being faithful. *
Life and death are as different as fire and water,
and the Lord will give you whichever you choose.
The Lord is extremely wise and tremendously powerful. He can see all things—
every deed that we do— and if we fear him, he will watch over us.
He has neither commanded nor given permission for anyone to be evil or to sin.
